seo.title: 30 Portfolio Project Ideas for DAO Contributors
seo.description: Discover portfolio project ideas for DAO contributors. From governance participation to workstream leadership, build a portfolio that demonstrates DAO expertise.

content.intro: DAO contribution is a new career path. These projects help you demonstrate your ability to contribute meaningfully to decentralized organizations.

items.title: Governance Participation Log
items.description: Document all your governance votes, discussions, and rationale.

items.title: Proposal Author Portfolio
items.description: Write and submit governance proposals. Document outcomes.

items.title: Delegate Platform
items.description: Create a delegate platform documenting your values and voting history.

items.title: Governance Analysis Reports
items.description: Write regular analysis of governance proposals before votes.

items.title: Cross-DAO Governance Study
items.description: Compare governance structures across multiple DAOs.

sections.heading: Workstream Leadership
sections.description: Lead or contribute to DAO workstreams.

items.title: Workstream Lead Experience
items.description: Lead a DAO workstream. Document goals, progress, and outcomes.

items.title: Grant Program Management
items.description: Help manage a DAO grants program. Review applications, track outcomes.

items.title: Treasury Management Contribution
items.description: Contribute to treasury management decisions and reporting.

items.title: Operations Documentation
items.description: Document DAO operations processes and create SOPs.

items.title: Contributor Onboarding Program
items.description: Design and run onboarding for new DAO contributors.

sections.heading: Tools and Improvement
sections.description: Build tools or improve DAO operations.

items.title: Governance Dashboard
items.description: Build a dashboard tracking governance metrics for a DAO.

items.title: Compensation Framework
items.description: Design a compensation framework for DAO contributors.

items.title: Voting Power Analysis
items.description: Analyze voting power distribution and concentration.

items.title: DAO Improvement Proposal
items.description: Identify operational issues and propose concrete improvements.

items.title: Meeting Facilitation
items.description: Facilitate DAO meetings. Document agendas, outcomes, and action items.

items.title: DAO space Report
items.description: Research and document the DAO ecosystem in a specific vertical.

items.title: Governance Attack Analysis
items.description: Analyze potential governance attack vectors for a DAO.

items.title: Voter Behavior Study
items.description: Analyze voting patterns and participation trends.

items.title: DAO Legal Structure Research
items.description: Research legal wrapper options for DAOs.

items.title: Community Call Hosting
items.description: Host regular community calls for the DAO.

items.title: Governance Education Content
items.description: Create educational content explaining DAO governance.

items.title: Newsletter for Token Holders
items.description: Run a newsletter keeping token holders informed.

items.title: Ambassador for the DAO
items.description: Represent the DAO externally at events and in communities.

items.title: DAO Wiki Creation
items.description: Build comprehensive wiki documentation for the DAO ecosystem.

items.title: Translation and Localization
items.description: Translate governance proposals and docs for non-English communities.

items.title: Treasury Diversification Proposal
items.description: Research and propose treasury diversification strategies.

items.title: Expense Tracking Dashboard
items.description: Build transparent expense tracking for DAO expenditures.

items.title: Token Buyback Analysis
items.description: Analyze whether token buybacks benefit the DAO and holders.

items.title: Revenue Attribution Report
items.description: Track and attribute revenue sources for DAO transparency.

items.title: Budget Proposal Template
items.description: Create standardized budget proposal templates for workstreams.

items.title: Inter-DAO Partnership Proposal
items.description: Identify cooperation and propose partnerships between DAOs.

items.title: DAO Collaboration Framework
items.description: Design frameworks for how DAOs can collaborate effectively.

items.title: Metagovernance Platform
items.description: Build platform tracking governance across multiple DAOs.

gettingStarted.title: Join and participate
gettingStarted.description: Pick a DAO aligned with your interests. Start participating.

gettingStarted.title: Vote and discuss
gettingStarted.description: Vote on proposals. Explain your reasoning in forums.

gettingStarted.title: Find your niche
gettingStarted.description: Identify where you can contribute: ops, treasury, community, etc.

gettingStarted.title: Build relationships
gettingStarted.description: Get to know other contributors. DAOs are people.

gettingStarted.title: Document everything
gettingStarted.description: Keep records of your contributions for your portfolio.
